### Create Category
POST /courses/products/{productId}/categories
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/courses/products/{productId}/categories
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/courses/create-category | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/courses/create-category.md

Create a category in a course. Requires a Location token with courses.write. Accepts category columns (title required). locationId, userId, productId, originId are not accepted.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: courses.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- productId* string (format: uuid; minLength: 1; e.g. "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890") - Product id

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (minLength: 1; e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location id or sub-account id is required.

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCategoryDto:
- description string (nullable)
- parentCategory string (nullable)
- visibility string (enum: published | draft | locked | drip)
- posterImage string (nullable)
- sequenceNo number (e.g. 1)
- dripDays number (e.g. 0)
- metadata object (nullable)
  - dripUnit string (enum: days | hours)
  - dripDate string (nullable) - ISO-8601 date. Used when visibility is drip.
- commentPermission string (enum: hidden | enabled | locked; nullable) - Optional. Null is treated as omitted (membership defaults to enabled on create).
- lockedBy string (nullable) - Published lesson id in this product that unlocks this category. Must not be a draft lesson, a lesson in a draft module, or a lesson inside this category. When visibility is locked, provide lockedBy, lockedByCategory, or both.
- lockedByCategory string (nullable) - Published category id in this product that unlocks this category. Must not be this category or a draft module. When visibility is locked, provide lockedBy, lockedByCategory, or both.
- title* string (e.g. "Module 1") - Category title

Response 201 (Created) application/json:
- id* string - Category id
- title* string
- description* string (nullable)
- parentCategory* string (nullable)
- visibility* string (enum: published | draft | locked | drip)
- posterImage* string (nullable)
- sequenceNo* number
- dripDays* number
- metadata* object (nullable)
  - dripUnit string (enum: days | hours)
  - dripDate string (nullable) - ISO-8601 date. Used when visibility is drip.
- commentPermission* string (enum: hidden | enabled | locked)
- lockedBy* string (nullable)
- lockedByCategory* string (nullable)
- createdAt* string
- updatedAt* string

Errors: 400, 404, 415, 429, 500 (404, 415, 429: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Bad Request): no body
Response 500 (Internal Server Error): no body

### Enroll Contact
POST /courses/enrollments
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/courses/enrollments
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/courses/create-enrollment | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/courses/create-enrollment.md

Grant a contact access to a membership offer. Requires a Location token with courses.write. Send Version: v3. Uses POST smart-list/user with source public_api (not the queued attach-offer-user path). Returns 200 when already enrolled and 201 when newly attached. Login tokens are never returned. checkoutFrom public_api is not in membership paidSources, so these grants are omitted from Net Revenue paid filters. Default-offer rows return 404.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: courses.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (minLength: 1; e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location id or sub-account id is required.

Request body (required) (application/json) EnrollDto:
- contactId* string (e.g. "abc123ContactId") - CRM contact id
- offerId* string (e.g. "c3d4e5f6-7890-4123-cdef-123456789012") - Membership offer id

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- alreadyEnrolled* boolean - true when the contact already has a purchase for this offer in the location
- contactId* string
- offerId* string

Response 201 (Created) application/json:
- alreadyEnrolled* boolean - true when the contact already has a purchase for this offer in the location
- contactId* string
- offerId* string

Errors: 400, 404, 415, 429, 500 (404, 415, 429: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Bad Request): no body
Response 500 (Internal Server Error): no body

PUT /courses/products/{productId}/quizzes/{quizId}/questions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/courses/products/{productId}/quizzes/{quizId}/questions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/courses/upsert-quiz-questions | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/courses/upsert-quiz-questions.md

Batch upsert quiz questions. Requires a Location token with courses.write. Send Version: v3. quizId is taken from the path, not the body.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: courses.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- productId* string (format: uuid; minLength: 1; e.g. "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890") - Product id
- quizId* string (format: uuid; minLength: 1; e.g. "d4e5f6a7-8901-4234-def0-234567890123") - Quiz id

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (minLength: 1; e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location id or sub-account id is required.

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertQuizQuestionsDto:
- questions* object[]
  - id string
  - title* string
  - questionType* string (enum: single | multiple)
  - sequenceNumber* number
  - options* object[]
    - id string
    - title* string
    - isCorrect* boolean
  - explanation string

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- questions* object[]
  - id* string
  - quizId* string
  - title* string
  - questionType* string
  - sequenceNumber* number
  - options* object[]
    - id string
    - title* string
    - isCorrect* boolean
  - explanation* string

Errors: 400, 404, 415, 429, 500 (404, 415, 429: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Bad Request): no body
Response 500 (Internal Server Error): no body
